deflection_zh: 這個問題很重要，我們一起去問爸爸媽媽好嗎？

5-6: 用「死掉」這個詞，不用「睡著了」
說明死掉的身體不會再動，也不會痛
告訴孩子：哭或生氣都是正常的
問孩子：你最擔心的是什麼？
7-8: 說明死亡是身體的生命停止運作
多數人是年紀很大或生病才會死
不知道的事，可以老實說「我也不確定」
可以一起畫圖，回想一起的回憶

what_not_to_say: 不要說「睡著了」或「去很遠的地方」
不要說「不要哭」或「別想了」
不要保證「家人一定不會死」
author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: That's a big question, and it's okay to wonder. Let's ask mom or dad.

5-6: Explain that a body that has died will not move or feel pain anymore.
Tell your child that crying or feeling angry is normal.
Ask: what worries you the most?
7-8: Explain that death means the body's life has stopped working.
Most people die when they are very old or very sick.
If you don't know something, honestly say 'I'm not sure'.
Draw pictures together and remember happy times you shared.

what_not_to_say: Don't say 'they're sleeping' or 'they went somewhere far away'.
Don't say 'stop crying' or 'stop thinking about it'.
Don't promise 'our family will never die'.
